title: Welcome to the Farm
description:
This is a pack about raising animals and running a farm. A few things work differently from normal Minecraft.

**Nothing will attack you.** Hostile mobs don't spawn. No creepers, no skeletons, no need to build walls or dig a bunker on night one.

**You still get hungry.** Difficulty is Normal, not Peaceful — food still matters, and growing it is the point.

**Emeralds come from selling farm goods**, not from villagers. There are no villages.

This journal will fill in as you go. Check it whenever the badge appears on your inventory screen.
